title: u16-lane PLE base-case kernel (6823c8a0 Phase 6d)
description:
Phase 6d follow-up under epic `026fc832`. 6823c8a0 R0 (panelized PLE) closes GF(7), GF(31), GF(127), GF(241) PLE cells to PASS, but GF(65521) PLE cells (A8 rows 14-17 + new n=1024 cells) remain SHORTFALL at ratios 2.04-3.44× because the design `2e8c5a29` § 9 leaves the GF(65521) base case scalar (the byte-lane panel kernel doesn't apply to u16 medium primes). Closing the GF(65521) PLE cells requires writing a u16-lane analogue of the AVX2 panel-base elimination kernel. ## Background After 6823c8a0 R0 (commits `a238ef36..6607005d`): - GF(65521)/64/uniform: 3.319× (was 2.95×; slightly worse — base case overhead dominates at n=64) - GF(65521)/64/deficient: 3.187× (was 3.11×) - GF(65521)/256/uniform: 2.234× (was 7.34× — Schur-update path delivers most of the speedup) - GF(65521)/256/deficient: 2.283× (was 8.58×) - GF(65521)/1024 uniform / deficient: 3.443× / 2.038× (NEW cells; baseline unmeasured) The R0 worker's analysis: "Per the design § 9, GF(65521)'s base case stays scalar; it inherits Schur-update speedup from the medium-prime `fp_medium` GEMM via `gemm_axpy_into_view`. That lift does close ratios substantially but not to 1.5×. The remaining gap reflects the gf2 medium-prime GEMM ceiling vs fflas Modular." When 695350fd (Phase 6b u16 BLIS for fp_medium) lands, the Schur-update path improves further. But the PLE base case remains scalar for GF(65521) under the current design. To close the GF(65521) PLE FAIL cells to ≤ 1.5×, a dedicated u16-lane PLE base case is needed. ## Scope Write a u16-lane analogue of `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/fp_small_ple.rs` (the byte-lane panel-base kernel from 6823c8a0 R0). Mirror the structure: 1. Process up to MR=2 rows per panel iteration (u16 lanes mean fewer rows fit in 16 AVX2 registers). 2. For each column in `[col_lo, col_hi)`: - Find pivot row at or below current rank. - Swap rows via existing `MatViewMut::swap_rows`. - Scale the pivot column below pivot via batch Barrett (call into the u16 lane variant of `barrett_reduce_lane32` — see `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/fp_medium.rs` for the existing u16 reduction primitive used by `fp_medium_gemm_panel`). - Update remaining panel columns via panel-batched MAC + reduce. 3. Add a safe wrapper in `crates/gf2-kernels-simd::fp_medium_ple` (analogous to `fp_small_ple::detect`). 4. Update `Fp

` for `P` in (251, 65536) to override `PLE_PANEL_COLS` to an appropriate u16-lane KC (likely `KC = 128` for the smaller register budget). 5. Update `ple_in_place_window` dispatch to route u16 medium primes to the new kernel when `win <= PLE_PANEL_COLS_u16 && AVX2_avail && (251 < P < 65536)`. The Schur-update path stays as-is (medium prime u16 dot via `gemm_axpy_into_view → fp_medium_try_dot_product`; further improved by 695350fd when that lands). ## Success Criteria - [hard] GF(65521) PLE A8 rows 14-17 + new n=1024 cells: ratio gf2/fflas ≤ 1.5× on 5-trial CCX1-pinned bench (flock-guarded via `dev/benchmarks/ccx1-bench-flock.sh`) on the Zen 3 reference host. Reference fflas single-thread numbers per `dev/bench_results/2026-04-26-reference.csv` and supplements. - [hard] No regression on currently-PASSing GF(p) cells (delta ≤ 5% on CCX1-pinned bench with warmup-matched protocol). Use the 6823c8a0 R0 evidence CSV as the baseline. - [hard] Bit-exact correctness preserved (proptest sweep at boundary lengths {0, 1, 15, 16, 17, 63, 64, 65} for GF(65521); reuse the existing `prop_ple_panelized_matches_contract_fp65521` shape). - [hard] No BLAS dependency; pure Rust + AVX2. - [hard] Unsafe stays in `gf2-kernels-simd` (no new unsafe in `gf2-core`). - [hard] Evidence doc at `dev/bench_results/--fp-medium-ple.md` with before/after + non-regression sweep. - [hard] Coordinates with 695350fd if both land in close succession (695350fd improves the Schur path; this task improves the base case; together they close GF(65521) PLE cleanly). ## Out of scope - Route A / GF(251) PLE work (handled by 6823c8a0 R1 recursive PLUQ). - Echelon / invert / solve impls (sibling tasks). - AVX-512 (epic `7f809931`). - BLAS delegation (user-rejected). - Mersenne31 PLE (separate; design § 5 explicitly excludes). ## Notes - Filed session 9 (2026-05-26) per user-approved deferral of 6823c8a0 SC#4 for GF(65521) cells. - References: 2e8c5a29 design § 9; 6823c8a0 R0 evidence at `dev/bench_results/2026-05-26-6823c8a0-panelized-ple.md`; existing fp_medium u16 panel kernel at `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/fp_medium.rs` (commit `ba4a10e9`).
